name: unwordy
description: Keeps coding-agent comments, commits, PRs and replies concise. Local checks and optional hooks catch attribution and filler before review.

interface.shortDescription: Write like a terse developer, not an assistant
interface.longDescription: Loads a short writing profile, teaches repo conventions and checks diffs, commit messages and review text with local rules. Host hooks can stop matching writes before review.
defaultPrompt: Write the commit message for these changes
Rewrite this PR description so a human would write it
